title: TUSI: A Citation-Grounded Graph-Based Benchmark
abstract: arXiv:2611.21823v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Evaluating retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems in Persian law remains challenging because benchmarks lack realism, grounding, and coverage of legal reasoning. Existing resources are either synthetically generated from statutory texts, lacking natural information needs, or derived from informal legal question--answer sources without explicit linkage to authoritative legal documents, making them unsuitable for rigorous evaluation of grounded legal reasoning. To address this gap, we introduce TUSI-Bench, a structured Persian legal benchmark designed for the evaluation of RAG-based systems. TUSI-Bench is built upon a multi-layered legal knowledge framework containing 7,261 legal articles and integrating codified statutes, legal commentaries, doctrinal writings, and Supreme Court unification rulings. translated_abstract: 对波斯语（伊朗）法律领域的检索增强生成（RAG）系统进行评估仍然具有挑战性，因为现有基准缺乏真实性、引用溯源性以及对法律推理的覆盖。现有资源要么是从成文法文本中人工合成的，缺乏自然的信息需求；要么来源于非正式的法律问答资源，与权威法律文件之间没有明确的关联，因此不适合对有据可依的法律推理进行严格评估。为弥补这一空白，我们提出了TUSI-Bench，一个专为评估基于RAG的系统而设计的结构化波斯语法律基准。TUSI-Bench建立在一个多层法律知识框架之上，该框架包含7,261条法律条文，并整合了成文法典、法律评注、学理著作以及最高法院统一裁定。我们还构建了一个连接法条与法律概念的知识图谱，以支持结构感知的检索。基于这一基础，TUSI
tldr: 该论文提出了TUSI-Bench——一个建立在包含7,261条法律条文的多层知识框架和法律知识图谱之上的结构化波斯语法律基准，用于对具有引用溯源能力的法律RAG系统进行严格评估。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces TUSI-Bench, a citation-grounded structured Persian legal benchmark built upon a multi-layered framework of 7,261 legal articles and a legal knowledge graph, designed for rigorous evaluation of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems in grounded legal reasoning.
